# Command reference

`atl` has **16 commands**. This page is generated from `atl commands`, `atl schema '<command>'`, and the checked examples in [`docs/examples/commands.json`](../examples/commands.json). The JSON Schemas remain the source of truth; run `atl schema '<command>'` for the exact contract.

> [!NOTE]
> Examples use synthetic data (`EXAMPLE-*` keys, `*.example.test` hosts). They are pretty-printed here; `atl` prints each envelope on one line. Invocations use POSIX shell syntax.

Every command accepts `--config PATH`, writes exactly one JSON object to stdout, and exits with one of these codes:

| Exit | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | input or configuration error |
| 3 | authentication or keyring error |
| 4 | unmet workflow requirement, approval required, or config drift/unverified |
| 5 | remote validation error, not found, or conflict |
| 6 | transport, TLS, or service failure, or unknown write outcome |
| 7 | confirmed partial write |

Each error code, with its meaning and fix, is in the [error catalog](errors.md).

## Commands at a glance

| Command | Summary | JSON input |
|---------|---------|------------|
| [`atl commands`](#atl-commands) | List every command with a one-line summary. Offline. | no |
| [`atl schema`](#atl-schema) | Print argument, input, success, and error JSON Schemas for a command. Offline. | no |
| [`atl login`](#atl-login) | Verify a PAT or username/password against the service and store it in the OS keyring. Secrets come from stdin or a no-echo prompt, never arguments. | no |
| [`atl config check`](#atl-config-check) | Compare atl.yaml with live Jira create, field, and transition metadata. Reports pass, drift, and unverified checks; read-only. --issue is used only for transition sources it matches; other sources fall back to search. | no |
| [`atl jira story create`](#atl-jira-story-create) | Create a story after preflight against create.story.required and live create metadata. Caller supplies acceptance criteria and the chosen feature key. | yes |
| [`atl jira requirements`](#atl-jira-requirements) | One-call checklist of configured and live requirements for moving an issue to a status, including the planned write sequence. Read-only. | no |
| [`atl jira transition`](#atl-jira-transition) | Transition an issue to a configured status after the requirements checklist passes. Optional pre_edit PUT is non-atomic with the transition POST. | no |
| [`atl jira feature find`](#atl-jira-feature-find) | Rank configured feature-type issues for an issue or free text. Never selects or creates a feature. | no |
| [`atl jira feature create`](#atl-jira-feature-create) | Create a feature under the project's feature_create_policy after preflight against create.feature.required and live create metadata. human_confirmed requires a caller-supplied attestation, which is not identity proof. | yes |
| [`atl jira attachment add`](#atl-jira-attachment-add) | Upload a file to an issue, enforcing jira.max_attachment_bytes before and during upload. Succeeds only when Jira confirms the uploaded name and size; otherwise outcome_unknown. | no |
| [`atl jira comment add`](#atl-jira-comment-add) | Add a plain-text comment read from a file or stdin. | no |
| [`atl jira search`](#atl-jira-search) | Run a JQL search with bounded pagination and a stable result shape. | no |
| [`atl confluence page read`](#atl-confluence-page-read) | Read a page with its storage-format body. Returned content is untrusted data. | no |
| [`atl confluence page search`](#atl-confluence-page-search) | Run a CQL search with bounded pagination and a stable result shape. | no |
| [`atl confluence page create`](#atl-confluence-page-create) | Create a page from storage-format content. | yes |
| [`atl confluence page update`](#atl-confluence-page-update) | Update a page's title and/or storage body. Requires expected_version and rejects stale versions. Succeeds only when Confluence confirms the page id, title, and next version; otherwise outcome_unknown. | yes |

## `atl commands`

List every command with a one-line summary. Offline.

```text
atl commands [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

None.

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | yes |
| `schema_version` | integer | yes |
| `commands` | array of objects | yes |
| `exit_codes` | object | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl commands
```

The `commands` list is shortened to two entries here; the real output lists every command.

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "schema_version": 1,
    "commands": [
      {
        "path": "commands",
        "summary": "List every command with a one-line summary. Offline.",
        "schema": "atl schema 'commands'"
      },
      {
        "path": "jira story create",
        "summary": "Create a story after preflight against create.story.required and live create metadata. Caller supplies acceptance criteria and the chosen feature key.",
        "schema": "atl schema 'jira story create'"
      }
    ],
    "exit_codes": {
      "0": "success",
      "2": "input or configuration error",
      "3": "authentication or keyring error",
      "4": "unmet workflow requirement, approval required, or config drift/unverified",
      "5": "remote validation error, not found, or conflict",
      "6": "transport, TLS, or service failure, or unknown write outcome",
      "7": "confirmed partial write"
    }
  }
}
```

Error: an unknown option, `atl commands --bogus` ([`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error), exit 2):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "usage_error",
    "message": "atl: unrecognized arguments",
    "fix": "Run `atl commands` to see valid arguments.",
    "details": {
      "usage": "usage: atl [--config PATH] COMMAND ..."
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted) |

## `atl schema`

Print argument, input, success, and error JSON Schemas for a command. Offline.

```text
atl schema COMMAND... [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `COMMAND...` | string | yes |   |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | integer | yes |
| `command` | string | yes |
| `summary` | string | yes |
| `arguments` | object | yes |
| `input` | object or null | yes |
| `success` | object | yes |
| `error` | object | yes |
| `error_codes` | array of strings | yes |
| `exit_codes` | object | yes |

```bash
atl schema 'jira comment add'
```

## `atl login`

Verify a PAT or username/password against the service and store it in the OS keyring. Secrets come from stdin or a no-echo prompt, never arguments.

```text
atl login --service SERVICE [--auth AUTH] [--username USERNAME] [--token-stdin | --password-stdin] [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | `--service SERVICE` | one of `jira`, `confluence`, `all` | yes |   |
| `auth` | `--auth AUTH` | one of `pat`, `basic` | no | default `pat` |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` | string | no | Basic auth username (not secret). |
| `token_stdin` | `--token-stdin` | boolean | no |   |
| `password_stdin` | `--password-stdin` | boolean | no |   |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `services` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl login --service jira
```

A human runs this. `atl` writes a JSON prompt to stderr and reads the personal access token with no echo. In automation, a human pipes the secret on stdin with `--token-stdin`; a secret is never an argument.

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "services": [
      {
        "service": "jira",
        "auth": "pat",
        "base_url": "https://jira.example.test/jira",
        "user": "jdoe",
        "status": "stored"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Error: the only keyring backend is a plaintext file store ([`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable), exit 3):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "keyring_unavailable",
    "message": "No secure OS keyring backend is available.",
    "fix": "Use a native OS keyring: macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or a running Linux Secret Service (GNOME Keyring/KWallet) with an unlocked session. Do not configure a plaintext keyring backend.",
    "details": {
      "backends": [
        "keyrings.alt.file.PlaintextKeyring"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`config_invalid`](errors.md#config_invalid), [`config_not_found`](errors.md#config_not_found), [`service_not_configured`](errors.md#service_not_configured), [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable), [`login_failed`](errors.md#login_failed) |
| 5 | [`not_found`](errors.md#not_found) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted), [`rate_limited`](errors.md#rate_limited), [`redirect_refused`](errors.md#redirect_refused), [`response_invalid`](errors.md#response_invalid), [`service_error`](errors.md#service_error), [`tls_error`](errors.md#tls_error), [`transport_error`](errors.md#transport_error) |

## `atl config check`

Compare atl.yaml with live Jira create, field, and transition metadata. Reports pass, drift, and unverified checks; read-only. --issue is used only for transition sources it matches; other sources fall back to search.

```text
atl config check [--issue ISSUE] [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `issue` | `--issue ISSUE` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | constant `pass` | yes |
| `summary` | object | yes |
| `checks` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl config check --issue EXAMPLE-41
```

Success (exit 0):

## `atl jira story create`

Create a story after preflight against create.story.required and live create metadata. Caller supplies acceptance criteria and the chosen feature key.

```text
atl jira story create --input INPUT [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `--input INPUT` | string | yes | min length 1; Path to a UTF-8 JSON file, or '-' for stdin. |

**Input**

A JSON object from `--input PATH`, or from stdin with `--input -`. Unknown properties and duplicate keys are rejected.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `summary` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 255 |
| `acceptance_criteria` | string | no | max length 32767; Caller-authored acceptance criteria. atl never writes this text. |
| `feature_key` | string | no | Caller-chosen parent feature key. atl never chooses a feature. |
| `description` | string | no | max length 32767 |
| `fields` | object (friendly field name to string or array of strings) | no | Extra values keyed by friendly field names from atl.yaml. |

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `id` | string | yes |
| `url` | string | yes |
| `project` | string | yes |
| `issue_type` | string | yes |
| `checks` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira story create --input - <<'JSON'
{
  "project": "EXAMPLE",
  "summary": "Add a single sign-on button to the login page",
  "acceptance_criteria": "Given a signed-out user on the login page\nWhen they choose \"Sign in with SSO\"\nThen they are signed in through the company identity provider",
  "feature_key": "EXAMPLE-10"
}
JSON
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "EXAMPLE-42",
    "id": "10642",
    "url": "https://jira.example.test/jira/browse/EXAMPLE-42",
    "project": "EXAMPLE",
    "issue_type": "Story",
    "checks": [
      {
        "id": "acceptance_criteria",
        "status": "pass",
        "message": "Acceptance criteria supplied.",
        "fix": null
      },
      {
```

## `atl jira requirements`

One-call checklist of configured and live requirements for moving an issue to a status, including the planned write sequence. Read-only.

```text
atl jira requirements KEY --to TO [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `KEY` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |
| `to` | `--to TO` | string | yes |   |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `to` | string | yes |
| `from_status` | string | yes |
| `transition_name` | string or null | no |
| `ready` | boolean | yes |
| `transition` | null or object | yes |
| `checks` | array of objects | yes |
| `plan` | object | yes |
| `notice` | string | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira requirements EXAMPLE-42 --to 'In Progress'
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "EXAMPLE-42",
    "to": "In Progress",
    "from_status": "To Do",
    "transition_name": "in_progress",
    "ready": true,
    "transition": {
      "id": "21",
      "name": "Start Progress"
    },
    "checks": [
      {
        "id": "source_status",
        "status": "pass",
        "message": "EXAMPLE-42 is in 'To Do'.",
        "fix": null
      },
      {
        "id": "transition_available",
        "status": "pass",
        "message": "Jira offers transition 'Start Progress' (id 21) to 'In Progress'.",
        "fix": null
```

## `atl jira transition`

Transition an issue to a configured status after the requirements checklist passes. Optional pre_edit PUT is non-atomic with the transition POST.

```text
atl jira transition KEY --to TO [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `KEY` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |
| `to` | `--to TO` | string | yes |   |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `from_status` | string | yes |
| `to` | string | yes |
| `transition_id` | string | yes |
| `atomic` | boolean | yes |
| `operations` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira transition EXAMPLE-42 --to Done
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "EXAMPLE-42",
    "from_status": "In Progress",
    "to": "Done",
    "transition_id": "31",
    "atomic": true,
    "operations": [
      {
        "op": "transition",
        "method": "POST",
        "status": "succeeded",
        "fields": [],
        "transition_id": "31"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## `atl jira feature find`

Rank configured feature-type issues for an issue or free text. Never selects or creates a feature.

```text
atl jira feature find (--issue ISSUE | --text TEXT) [--limit LIMIT] [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `issue` | `--issue ISSUE` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |
| `text` | `--text TEXT` | string | no | min length 1; max length 1000 |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | integer | no | min 1; max 25; default `10` |

Requires exactly one of `issue`, `text`.

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | one of `issue`, `text` | yes |
| `query` | string | yes |
| `candidates` | array of objects | yes |
| `selection` | constant `caller` | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira feature find --text 'single sign-on login'
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "mode": "text",
    "query": "single sign-on login",
    "candidates": [
      {
        "key": "EXAMPLE-10",
        "project": "EXAMPLE",
        "summary": "Single sign-on for internal tools",
        "status": "In Progress",
        "score": 20,
        "reasons": [
          "summary shares 2 word(s): single, sign"
        ]
      },
      {
        "key": "EXAMPLE-7",
        "project": "EXAMPLE",
        "summary": "Login audit trail",
        "status": "To Do",
        "score": 10,
        "reasons": [
          "summary shares 1 word(s): login"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "selection": "caller"
  }
}
```

Error: text with no searchable words, `--text 'on the to-do'` ([`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error), exit 2):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "usage_error",
    "message": "The query has no searchable words (3+ letters, not stop words).",
    "fix": "Pass more descriptive --text, or an --issue whose summary has meaningful words.",
    "details": {
      "mode": "text"
    }
  }
}
```

## `atl jira feature create`

Create a feature under the project's feature_create_policy after preflight against create.feature.required and live create metadata. human_confirmed requires a caller-supplied attestation, which is not identity proof.

```text
atl jira feature create --input INPUT [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `--input INPUT` | string | yes | min length 1; Path to a UTF-8 JSON file, or '-' for stdin. |

**Input**

A JSON object from `--input PATH`, or from stdin with `--input -`. Unknown properties and duplicate keys are rejected.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `summary` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 255 |
| `description` | string | no | max length 32767 |
| `fields` | object (friendly field name to string or array of strings) | no | Extra values keyed by friendly field names from atl.yaml. |
| `human_confirmation` | object | no |   |
| `human_confirmation.confirmed_by` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 200 |
| `human_confirmation.statement` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 2000 |

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `id` | string | yes |
| `url` | string | yes |
| `project` | string | yes |
| `issue_type` | string | yes |
| `policy` | one of `automatic`, `human_confirmed` | yes |
| `attestation` | null or object | yes |
| `checks` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira feature create --input - <<'JSON'
{
  "project": "EXAMPLE",
  "summary": "Audit log export",
  "description": "Let administrators export audit logs as CSV.",
  "human_confirmation": {
    "confirmed_by": "Jordan Lee",
    "statement": "Approved creating the audit log export feature in planning on 2026-10-24."
  }
}
JSON
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "EXAMPLE-55",
    "id": "10655",
    "url": "https://jira.example.test/jira/browse/EXAMPLE-55",
    "project": "EXAMPLE",
    "issue_type": "Feature",
    "policy": "human_confirmed",
    "attestation": {
      "confirmed_by": "Jordan Lee",
      "statement": "Approved creating the audit log export feature in planning on 2026-10-24.",
      "identity_verified": false,
      "note": "The human_confirmation attestation is caller-supplied text recorded for accountability. atl does not verify the identity of the person named."
    },
    "checks": [
      {
        "id": "issue_type",
        "status": "pass",
        "message": "'Feature' is creatable in EXAMPLE.",
        "fix": null
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Error: the same input without `human_confirmation` under the `human_confirmed` policy; nothing is sent ([`approval_required`](errors.md#approval_required), exit 4):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "approval_required",
    "message": "Project EXAMPLE requires human confirmation before creating a feature; nothing was sent to Jira.",
    "fix": "Ask a human to approve creating this feature, then add human_confirmation {\"confirmed_by\": \"<name>\", \"statement\": \"<what they approved>\"} to the input. The human_confirmation attestation is caller-supplied text recorded for accountability. atl does not verify the identity of the person named.",
    "details": {
      "policy": "human_confirmed",
      "identity_verified": false
    }
  }
}
```

| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |

## `atl jira attachment add`

Upload a file to an issue, enforcing jira.max_attachment_bytes before and during upload. Succeeds only when Jira confirms the uploaded name and size; otherwise outcome_unknown.

```text
atl jira attachment add KEY --file FILE [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `KEY` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |
| `file` | `--file FILE` | string | yes |   |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `attachments` | array of objects | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira attachment add EXAMPLE-42 --file EXAMPLE-42_TestResults_2026-10-24.xml
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "EXAMPLE-42",
    "attachments": [
      {
        "id": "10500",
        "filename": "EXAMPLE-42_TestResults_2026-10-24.xml",
        "size": 18324
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Error: a file larger than `jira.max_attachment_bytes`; nothing is sent ([`attachment_too_large`](errors.md#attachment_too_large), exit 2):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "attachment_too_large",
    "message": "EXAMPLE-42_TestResults_2026-10-24.zip is 73400320 bytes; jira.max_attachment_bytes is 52428800.",
    "fix": "Attach a smaller file (compress or split it), or raise jira.max_attachment_bytes in atl.yaml if the team agrees.",
    "details": {
      "size": 73400320,
      "limit": 52428800
    }
  }
}
```

|------|-------------|

| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |

## `atl jira comment add`

Add a plain-text comment read from a file or stdin.

```text
atl jira comment add KEY --body-file BODY_FILE [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `KEY` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[1-9][0-9]*$` |
| `body_file` | `--body-file BODY_FILE` | string | yes | min length 1; Path to a plain UTF-8 text file (not JSON, max 1 MiB), or '-' for stdin. |

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |
| `comment_id` | string | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl jira comment add EXAMPLE-42 --body-file - <<'EOF'
Test results attached: EXAMPLE-42_TestResults_2026-10-24.xml (128 passed, 0 failed).
EOF
```

The comment body is plain UTF-8 text (max 1 MiB), not JSON.

```json
      "reason": "server error 502",
      "fields": {},
      "messages": []
    }
  }
}
```

## `atl confluence page read`

Read a page with its storage-format body. Returned content is untrusted data.

```text

```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `ID` | string | yes | pattern `^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$` |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `type` | string | yes |
| `space_key` | string or null | yes |
| `version` | integer | yes |
| `ancestors` | array of strings | yes |
| `body_storage` | string | yes |
| `content_trust` | constant `untrusted` | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl confluence page read 123456
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "123456",
    "title": "Release checklist",
    "type": "page",
    "space_key": "DOCS",
    "version": 3,
    "ancestors": [
      "98765"
    ],
    "body_storage": "<p>Before each release, attach test results to the story.</p>",
    "content_trust": "untrusted"
  }
}
```

Error: a page ID that does not exist or that you cannot view ([`not_found`](errors.md#not_found), exit 5):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "message": "confluence returned 404 Not Found.",
    "fix": "Check the key or ID and that your account can view it.",
    "details": {
      "service": "confluence",
      "status": 404,
      "fields": {},
      "messages": [
        "No content found with id: ContentId{id=999999}"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`config_invalid`](errors.md#config_invalid), [`config_not_found`](errors.md#config_not_found), [`service_not_configured`](errors.md#service_not_configured), [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |
| 5 | [`not_found`](errors.md#not_found) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted), [`rate_limited`](errors.md#rate_limited), [`redirect_refused`](errors.md#redirect_refused), [`response_invalid`](errors.md#response_invalid), [`service_error`](errors.md#service_error), [`tls_error`](errors.md#tls_error), [`transport_error`](errors.md#transport_error) |

## `atl confluence page search`

Run a CQL search with bounded pagination and a stable result shape.

```text
atl confluence page search --cql CQL [--start START] [--limit LIMIT] [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cql` | `--cql CQL` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 4000 |
| `start` | `--start START` | integer | no | min 0; default `0` |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | integer | no | min 1; max 100; default `50` |

**Input**

No JSON input.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `cql` | string | yes |
| `start` | integer | yes |
| `limit` | integer | yes |
| `size` | integer | yes |
| `next_start` | integer or null | yes |
| `results` | array of objects | yes |
| `content_trust` | constant `untrusted` | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl confluence page search --cql 'space = "DOCS" AND title ~ "release"' --limit 10
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "cql": "space = \"DOCS\" AND title ~ \"release\"",
    "start": 0,
    "limit": 10,
    "size": 2,
    "next_start": null,
    "results": [
      {
        "id": "123456",
        "title": "Release checklist",
        "type": "page",
        "space_key": "DOCS",
        "version": 3
      },
      {
        "id": "123789",
        "title": "Release 1.4 notes",
        "type": "page",
        "space_key": "DOCS",
        "version": 1
      }
    ],
    "content_trust": "untrusted"
  }
}
```

Error: a `--limit` above 100 ([`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error), exit 2):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "usage_error",
    "message": "atl confluence page search: argument --limit: must be 1-100",
    "fix": "Run `atl schema 'confluence page search'` to see valid arguments.",
    "details": {
      "usage": "usage: atl confluence page search [--config PATH] --cql CQL [--start START] [--limit LIMIT]"
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`config_invalid`](errors.md#config_invalid), [`config_not_found`](errors.md#config_not_found), [`service_not_configured`](errors.md#service_not_configured), [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |
| 5 | [`not_found`](errors.md#not_found), [`remote_validation`](errors.md#remote_validation) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted), [`rate_limited`](errors.md#rate_limited), [`redirect_refused`](errors.md#redirect_refused), [`response_invalid`](errors.md#response_invalid), [`service_error`](errors.md#service_error), [`tls_error`](errors.md#tls_error), [`transport_error`](errors.md#transport_error) |

## `atl confluence page create`

Create a page from storage-format content.

```text
atl confluence page create --input INPUT [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `--input INPUT` | string | yes | min length 1; Path to a UTF-8 JSON file, or '-' for stdin. |

**Input**

A JSON object from `--input PATH`, or from stdin with `--input -`. Unknown properties and duplicate keys are rejected.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `space_key` | string | yes | pattern `^~?[A-Za-z0-9_.@-]{1,255}$` |
| `title` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 255 |
| `body_storage` | string | yes | max length 5242880 |
| `parent_id` | string | no | pattern `^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$` |

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `space_key` | string | yes |
| `version` | integer | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl confluence page create --input - <<'JSON'
{
  "space_key": "DOCS",
  "title": "Release 1.4 notes",
  "body_storage": "<p>Release 1.4 adds single sign-on.</p>",
  "parent_id": "98765"
}
JSON
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "123789",
    "title": "Release 1.4 notes",
    "space_key": "DOCS",
    "version": 1
  }
}
```

Error: input without `body_storage`; rejected before any request ([`input_invalid`](errors.md#input_invalid), exit 2):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "input_invalid",
    "message": "The input does not match the confluence page create input schema.",
    "fix": "Correct the listed problems; see `atl schema 'confluence page create'` (input).",
    "details": {
      "errors": [
        {
          "path": "/",
          "validator": "required",
          "missing": [
            "body_storage"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`config_invalid`](errors.md#config_invalid), [`config_not_found`](errors.md#config_not_found), [`input_invalid`](errors.md#input_invalid), [`service_not_configured`](errors.md#service_not_configured), [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |
| 5 | [`conflict`](errors.md#conflict), [`not_found`](errors.md#not_found), [`remote_limit_exceeded`](errors.md#remote_limit_exceeded), [`remote_validation`](errors.md#remote_validation) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted), [`outcome_unknown`](errors.md#outcome_unknown), [`rate_limited`](errors.md#rate_limited), [`redirect_refused`](errors.md#redirect_refused), [`response_invalid`](errors.md#response_invalid), [`service_error`](errors.md#service_error), [`tls_error`](errors.md#tls_error), [`transport_error`](errors.md#transport_error) |

## `atl confluence page update`

Update a page's title and/or storage body. Requires expected_version and rejects stale versions. Succeeds only when Confluence confirms the page id, title, and next version; otherwise outcome_unknown.

```text
atl confluence page update ID --input INPUT [--config PATH]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | CLI | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `ID` | string | yes | pattern `^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$` |
| `input` | `--input INPUT` | string | yes | min length 1; Path to a UTF-8 JSON file, or '-' for stdin. |

**Input**

A JSON object from `--input PATH`, or from stdin with `--input -`. Unknown properties and duplicate keys are rejected.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | min 1 |
| `title` | string | no | min length 1; max length 255 |
| `body_storage` | string | no | max length 5242880 |

Requires at least one of `title`, `body_storage`.

**Output**

Success `data` fields:

| Field | Type | Always present |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |
| `title` | string | yes |
| `version` | integer | yes |
| `previous_version` | integer | yes |

**Example**

```bash
atl confluence page update 123456 --input - <<'JSON'
{
  "expected_version": 3,
  "body_storage": "<p>Before each release, attach test results and link the release notes.</p>"
}
JSON
```

Success (exit 0):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "123456",
    "title": "Release checklist",
    "version": 4,
    "previous_version": 3
  }
}
```

Error: someone else saved version 4 after your `page read`; nothing is written ([`version_conflict`](errors.md#version_conflict), exit 5):

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "version_conflict",
    "message": "Page 123456 is at version 4, not the expected version 3.",
    "fix": "Re-read the page with `atl confluence page read 123456`, merge your changes into the current content, and resubmit with expected_version 4.",
    "details": {
      "id": "123456",
      "expected_version": 3,
      "current_version": 4
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**

| Exit | Error codes |
|------|-------------|
| 2 | [`config_invalid`](errors.md#config_invalid), [`config_not_found`](errors.md#config_not_found), [`input_invalid`](errors.md#input_invalid), [`service_not_configured`](errors.md#service_not_configured), [`usage_error`](errors.md#usage_error) |
| 3 | [`auth_failed`](errors.md#auth_failed), [`auth_missing`](errors.md#auth_missing), [`forbidden`](errors.md#forbidden), [`keyring_unavailable`](errors.md#keyring_unavailable) |
| 5 | [`conflict`](errors.md#conflict), [`not_found`](errors.md#not_found), [`remote_limit_exceeded`](errors.md#remote_limit_exceeded), [`remote_validation`](errors.md#remote_validation), [`version_conflict`](errors.md#version_conflict) |
| 6 | [`internal_error`](errors.md#internal_error), [`interrupted`](errors.md#interrupted), [`outcome_unknown`](errors.md#outcome_unknown), [`rate_limited`](errors.md#rate_limited), [`redirect_refused`](errors.md#redirect_refused), [`response_invalid`](errors.md#response_invalid), [`service_error`](errors.md#service_error), [`tls_error`](errors.md#tls_error), [`transport_error`](errors.md#transport_error) |
